skill_name: Design an empathy exercise for a remote team
workflow: One exercise for a remote team to foster empathy is the “However, I understand” exercise. Teams would be divided into pairs and give each other a situation that causes the other person to feel frustrated. The listener would then summarize their understanding of the situation and respond with “However, I understand why you feel that way,” without trying to offer any solutions.
